title: Meta wants to pay for its broad AI buildout with a newly created class of stock
slides: Can Meta fund its AI buildout without burning cash?
It plans a new class of stock to raise money
But the structure may dilute existing shareholders more than expected
Investors holding Meta shares need to watch the vote closely
Check the dilution terms before this structure passes
thread_text:
1. Meta's AI gamble

Meta plans a new class of stock to raise money for AI without burning cash. But the dilution may hit existing shareholders harder than expected.

2. New stock, new risks

The structure could dilute voting power and earnings per share more than investors anticipate. The details matter.

3. Vote could shift control

Meta's shareholders will vote on the new stock class. If passed, it may concentrate power and reduce your influence.

4. Dilution deeper than thought

Analysts warn the terms may dilute existing shareholders more than initially projected. Check the fine print before the vote.

5. Review before you vote

Find the dilution terms in Meta's proxy statement. Calculate the impact on your shares. Then decide how to vote.
